proximity_intro.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
proximity_intro.text: Keep your boots clear of the thread.

first_interaction.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
first_interaction.text: Bell above. Fountain below. West gate to our left. Black banners at the doors.

first_interaction.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
first_interaction.text: Do not tell me this is another chapel.

ask_bell.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_bell.text: The one above us is a chapel bell.

ask_bell.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_bell.text: We heard it after the order was given.

ask_bell.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_bell.text: That was why we gave the order.

ask_thread.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_thread.text: After Bellfall, the ledgers kept names that bodies no longer answered to.

ask_thread.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_thread.text: We tied the living. We tied the dead.

ask_thread.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_thread.text: When neither arrived, we tied the empty shroud.

ask_thread.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_thread.text: If yours pulls tight, stop walking.

ask_thread.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_thread.text: If it snaps, do not answer anyone behind you.

ask_orra.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_orra.text: Orra is not who you call before a death.

ask_orra.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_orra.text: She is who you call when the death arrives first.

ask_orra.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_orra.text: In time to witness who was missed.

ask_orra.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
ask_orra.text: If she arrives while you're still breathing, you've been counted wrong.

peaceful_exit.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
peaceful_exit.text: Some gates are closed by footsteps.

inspect_fountain.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
inspect_fountain.text: This is a basin. It is not the Fountain.

inspect_fountain.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
inspect_fountain.text: Wrong lip. Wrong depth. No east fracture.

inspect_fountain.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
inspect_fountain.text: Someone built this where the Fountain should be.
